patch_description: Following the recommendation: diversify the seed portfolio with three new distinct basins (9+4 two-cluster arc with different ratio, reversed-chirality spiral, perturbed 13-gon), and replace the single-incumbent phase-2 loop with alternating short re-anneals over the top-2 phase-1 results (Adam with lr=0.005, p0=200), since restarts around diverse good basins drove the historical gains.
